project_type: Next.js 16 app with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript
build_system: npm with Next.js build pipeline. AGENTS.md warns about Next.js breaking changes and instructs reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.
test_framework: No test framework configured - no test command or test files found
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npm run lint to check ESLint. 3. Run npm run build to verify successful production build.
environment_constraints: No test suite exists. Verification is lint + build. The RIOT_API_KEY env var is not set in sandbox but build should succeed without it since it's only used at runtime.
contribution_requirements: Follow AGENTS.md - read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for Next.js 16 specifics. Use responsive Tailwind CSS, semantic HTML, accessibility best practices.
key_patterns: Components are in app/components/, library code in lib/. Dark theme (gray-950 background, gray-100/200/300 text). Indigo accent color. Match cards use border colors for win/loss indication (green/red). MatchSummary type flows from API route through Dashboard state to MatchHistory and MatchCard. The API route at app/api/riot/route.ts constructs MatchSummary objects from Riot API responses.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js app router pages and components. app/api/riot/ - server-side API route. app/components/ - client components. lib/ - shared utilities and types. public/ - static assets.
